scenario.name: sustain-aa-male
scenario.ops_rule: ops with at <= i are applied in list order before output sample i is rendered; all ops here have at = 0, i.e. they run after HumanVoice::new and before the first render() call (so before the first control step)
scenario.provenance: as recon/R1-work/vectors `held_vowel("ɑ")` (= voice_male_110hz_aa-back_1s.f32): HumanVoice::new(48000, BODY_MALE, 2), set_source(f0 110), set_articulation(vowel_artic("ɑ", male), None), set_gate(1.0), 48000 samples in host blocks of 128

block_rule: block b = the b-th control() call; it runs before internal sample b*ctrl_every, i.e. before output sample b*ctrl_every/oversample = 64*b; values are the state right after that control() call
